videos.title: CU Boulder Racing Team - IMI Motorsports 01:09:59 (PB)
Robomaster 2019 Robotics Competition - Highlight Reel
videos.description:
A collection of highlights from this year's Robomaster competition. It's a little long so I'll be creating a sizzle reel to help promote the competition with a video that isn't 11 minutes long. Please let me know if I missed any other hype moments in the comments below!

Additionally I encourage anyone into robotics, and videogames like Dota 2/League of Legends, or other real-time strategy games to start a Robomaster team at their college. This international competition is hosted yearly in China, and I think there can be a much larger presence from the U.S. The robots fight in an arena and are either autonomous or controlled by players in a remote area. It actually feels like a mix between an FPS like Call of Duty, Robotics, and these MOBAs. I think its a really cool event and I hope it gains more traction!
